summary: Iteration 111 - Bug Fixes and Features Testing. All 10 items tested: 4 bugs + 6 features. Backend: 13/13 tests passed. Frontend: All critical flows verified via Playwright.

minor.issue: Order model was missing 'name' field - FIXED during testing by adding name field to Order, OrderCreate, and OrderUpdate models

issues: Sub-nav has Dashboard/Calendar/Kanban Board/Task List buttons which is intentional design for view switching within Productivity section

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Added 'name' field to Order model in /app/backend/models/orders.py - was missing and causing 500 error on order creation
Order auto-naming logic in routes/orders.py correctly generates DISPLAYNAME-MMDDYY format with suffix letters for same-day duplicates
Customer display_name auto-generation working correctly - removes spaces from company/name
Productivity filters bar correctly includes Tasks and Orders by default (itemTypes: ['job', 'task'])
Status filter dropdown has all expected options and filters items correctly
seed_data_creation: Created test customers and orders during testing (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 111 verified all 10 items. Key fixes: (1) Order model now has 'name' field for auto-naming feature. All bugs and features working correctly.

BUG_2_task_creation_from_calendar.details: Task creation from productivity calendar day modal works - shows success toast 'Task created' and task appears in day's task list

BUG_3_duplicate_view_nav.details: Productivity page has sub-nav with Dashboard/Calendar/Kanban Board/Task List buttons - this is intentional design for view switching within the Productivity section, not duplicate navigation

BUG_4_status_filter.details: Status filter dropdown works correctly - selecting 'open' filters items to only open status. Backend API supports statuses parameter.

FEATURE_5_customer_company_only.details: Customer creation with only company name (no personal name) succeeds. Name field auto-populated from company. display_name auto-generated without spaces.

FEATURE_5_display_name_auto_generation.details: Customer display_name auto-generated from company name with spaces removed (e.g., 'TEST Display Name Company' -> 'TESTDisplayNameCompany')

FEATURE_6_order_auto_naming.details: Order auto-naming works - generates DISPLAYNAME-MMDDYY format (e.g., 'TESTAUTONAMECOPR-041726'). Same-day duplicates get suffix letters.

FEATURE_8_dashboard_route.details: /dashboard route loads Dashboard page correctly - shows Total Customers, Active Orders, Pending Invoices, Today's Revenue, Quick Actions, etc.

FEATURE_10_expense_receipt_buttons.details: Expense dialog has 'Take Photo' and 'Choose File' buttons for receipt upload with camera and gallery icons

productivity_default_item_types.details: Productivity page shows both orders AND tasks by default - itemTypes includes ['job', 'task'] in filters

task_due_date.details: Task creation from calendar adds task with correct due_date matching the selected day
